s46_treason.offence: Every one commits treason who assists an enemy at war with Canada, or any armed forces against whom Canadian Forces are engaged in hostilities
s46_treason.relevance: Applicable if CDS facilitates foreign military forces operating against Canadian interests on Canadian soil

s52_sabotage.offence: Every one who does a prohibited act for a purpose prejudicial to the safety, security or defence of Canada
s52_sabotage.relevance: Applicable if CDS decisions deliberately degrade CAF operational capability

s122_breach_of_trust.offence: Every official who commits a breach of trust in connection with the duties of their office
s122_breach_of_trust.relevance: Applicable to any CDS who fails to act in the interest of CAF members and Canadian citizens

s130_nda.offence: Service offence — an act or omission that is punishable under the Criminal Code or any other Act of Parliament
s130_nda.relevance: NDA allows military charges to be laid against serving members including the CDS

s73_cowardice.offence: Every person who behaves before the enemy in such a manner as to show cowardice
s73_cowardice.relevance: Applicable if CDS surrenders digital battle space or fails to defend against identified threats

s74_unnecessary_danger.offence: Every person who unnecessarily endangers the lives of members of the Canadian Forces
s74_unnecessary_danger.relevance: Applicable if CDS decisions directly endanger CAF members

s77_ill_treatment.offence: Every officer who strikes or ill treats any person who by reason of rank is subordinate to him
s77_ill_treatment.relevance: Cruelty of an officer — applicable to systemic mistreatment of subordinates

s84_aiding_enemy.offence: Every person who knowingly harbours or conceals any person whom he knows, or has reasonable grounds to believe, to be an enemy
